about.title: Making vehicle condition transparent
about.p1: Pulsar.ai is a technology company that combines automated vehicle scanning, artificial intelligence and a digital inspection history. We are building a data platform on the actual condition of the body and underbody.
about.p2: It complements documents and vehicle history databases with the results of a visual inspection. Our goal is to make this data an accessible foundation for buying, servicing, lending and insurance.
about.img_alt: A car half photographed, half shown as a glowing scan wireframe
why.title: A car’s history doesn’t tell the whole story
why.p1: Ownership records and registered accidents tell only part of the story. Corrosion, impact marks, leaks and body modifications can stay outside databases and ordinary listing photos.
why.p2: Pulsar.ai adds another source of information — a scan of the car itself. It helps reveal visible signs of defects and identify which areas need a specialist's attention.
why.img_alt: A car above a glowing scan of its underbody with highlighted problem areas
sr.title: Vehicle inspection on the move
sr.p1: The car drives over the scanning module while side cameras capture the body surface. AI analyzes the images and flags signs of defects in a digital report.
sr.p2: No lift required — inspection fits into your existing vehicle flow.

how.title: From scan to digital report
how.s1_text: SmartRail captures images of the underbody and body as the car drives through.
how.s2_text: The system flags signs of corrosion, leaks, damage and impact on metal.
how.s3_text: Inspection data complements the car's available documented history.
how.s4_text: Follow-up scans let you compare results and track changes over time.
report.title: One car. Two layers<br class="br-xl"> of information.
report.lead: Documents tell you what was registered. A scan shows what the car looks like today. Pulsar.ai puts both in one report.
report.docs_sub: What was registered about the car.
report.docs_note: The scope of documented data depends on source availability and connected integrations.
report.scan_sub: What the body and underbody scan shows today: corrosion, leaks, damage, welds and impact marks.
history.title: It's not just about spotting a defect, but understanding how it changes
history.p1: Every Pulsar.ai scan is saved with a date. Repeat inspections reveal new or developing corrosion, fresh damage and changes after repairs.
history.p2: This history helps verify claims about a car's condition and factor changes into its valuation.
history.i1_desc: Rear quarter panel — dent, early signs of corrosion
history.i2_desc: Corrosion has spread · no new damage
history.i3_desc: Area treated · change recorded in history
aud.title: Vehicle condition data<br class="br-xl"> for your business
aud.c1_text: Extra insight when accepting and selling used cars. The digital report helps explain a car's condition to the buyer.
aud.c2_text: Actual vehicle condition data as an additional source when assessing collateral.
aud.c3_text: Record visible defects on the inspection date and compare condition across follow-up scans.
aud.c4_text: Automated scanning within traffic flow and new services built on the collected data.
dep.title: From technology to real‑world deployments
dep.lead: We are steadily expanding the technology — from inspecting a single car to a data platform for the whole automotive market.

dep.c2_text: Building an integration with the marketplace
vision.title: Towards a digital condition passport<br class="br-xl"> for every car
vision.p1: We see a future where a car's history includes not only documents and events, but consistent data on its physical condition.
vision.p2: Pulsar.ai is building the foundation for that passport: dated scans, analysis results and a history of changes.
